newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-WEAH SCORES TWICE AS MILAN GO TOP IN ITALY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEAH SCORES TWICE AS MILAN GO TOP IN ITALY.

text.p: George Weah scored twice and Roberto Baggio added a third on Sunday as Milan recovered from successive league and European Cup defeats to beat Napoli 3-1 and open up a temporary one-point lead at the top of Serie A.
With 12 points from six matches, the champions lie a point ahead of arch-rivals Inter, who will regain the lead if they beat Juventus at Turin in the evening match.
European champions Juventus, on 10 points, can also go top if they defeat Inter in a clash between the only clubs in serie A who have never been relegated.
Vicenza, for whom Giampiero Maini scored a late equaliser at Udinese, lead the group of five clubs tied for third place on 10 points -- Roma, Parma, Bologna and Juventus.
Roma, still reeling from their 3-0 UEFA Cup defeat to German side Karlsruhe, went down 2-1 at lowly Verona, while Parma suffered a surprise 2-1 home defeat to Perugia.
Holders Fiorentina warmed up for their midweek Italian Cup match at Bologna with a 2-0 victory in the same Dall'Ara stadium.
